name: Banh day
summary: Bánh dầy is a pounded glutinous-rice cake, one of the three local cakes of the Sa Pa table with bánh ngô and bánh đao.
origin: Highland kitchens of the northwest, where the cake is pounded from sticky rice.
seoTitle: Banh day in Sapa — pounded rice cake
seoDescription: Bánh dầy, a pounded glutinous-rice cake, one of the three local Sa Pa cakes.
